ideas.idea: Add a list of actual routes on the guides page, each with its own page and address
ideas.why: guides.vue promises graded routes but lists none, so adding named routes gives crawlers and readers real content.

ideas.idea: Add intro text to the home page describing the walks
ideas.why: index.vue has only an h1 and a button, so a short intro gives readers and machines something to understand and quote.

ideas.idea: Declare the real site URL in nuxt.config.ts so canonical links can be generated
ideas.why: No canonical link or site origin exists, and the sitemap uses the placeholder trailhead.example.

ideas.idea: Replace the button with a NuxtLink
ideas.why: This repeats the known problem about the button with router.push.

ideas.idea: Change the Sitemap line in robots.txt to an absolute URL
Turn on server rendering or prerender the routes
ideas.why: This repeats the known ssr: false problem.

ideas.idea: Remove the X-Robots-Tag noindex rule for /guides
Give each page its own title and description
